items.title: Football Game Notes #11
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – The 2026 regular season is winding down, with the Bowl-eligible Florida Atlantic football team set for its home finale against South Florida on Saturday, Nov. 21. Kickoff on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium is set for 2:30 p.m. on ESPN+.

items.title: Messer Magic Shirt Available at On-Campus Store
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – For fans of Florida Atlantic football, 'Messer Magic' T-shirts highlighting the historic season by fifth-year WR Easton Messer are available to purchase in-person at the Follett Campus Store and online HERE.

items.title: Football's Kittley and Vasey to be Joined by Josh McCowan on the Weekly Radio Show
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. - The Florida Atlantic Coaches Show, presented by Duffy's Sports Grill, returns this Thursday, Nov. 19, from 6 to 7 p.m. at the Duffy's Sports Grill on St. Andrew's Boulevard in Boca Raton.

items.title: Valsin and Rooks to Join Kittley’s Weekly ESPN+ Presser
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley will be joined by senior WR Kelby Valsin and graduate DB Tyson Rooks for a Tuesday, Nov. 16 press conference, airing live on ESPN+ at 12 p.m.

items.title: Kickoff Time at ECU Scheduled for 1 P.M.
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's 2026 regular season finale against East Carolina on Saturday, Nov. 28 is set for 1 p.m. on ESPN+, announced by the American Conference on Monday afternoon.

items.title: Messer Named Biletnikoff Award Semifinalist
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Easton Messer, Florida Atlantic football's dynamic fifth-year wide receiver, is one of 13 semifinalists for the Biletnikoff Award, as announced by the Tallahassee Quarterback Club (TQC) Foundation, Inc. on Monday afternoon.

items.title: Jet lag shows as FAU drops conference matchup against the University of Tulsa
items.summary: Florida Atlantic football (6-4, 3-3) dropped its conference matchup against the University of Tulsa (6-4, 3-3), 38-21. After experiencing some bumps in the road on their way to Tulsa, the Owls’ offense struggled to find its footing against the Golden Hurricane. Due to the FAA grounding all U.S. flights the day prior, FAU’s team buses...

items.title: Florida Atlantic Stalls in Tulsa
items.summary: TULSA, Okla. – Florida Atlantic football fell to Tulsa on the road, 38-21, on Saturday evening.

items.title: Football Game Time at Tulsa Moves to 7:15 PM ET
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – The American Conference announced on Friday that Florida Atlantic's football game at Tulsa has been changed to 7:15 p.m. ET Saturday.

items.title: Countdown to Kickoff: Game 10 at Tulsa
items.summary: TULSA, Okla. — Florida Atlantic football is on the road for a meeting with Tulsa on Saturday, Nov. 14. Kickoff on Skelly Field at H.A. Chapman Stadium is set for 7:15 p.m. ET, airing on ESPN+.

items.title: Where Are They Now: Johnnie Sloan
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Johnnie Sloan, a member of the inaugural Florida Atlantic football team, carries the lessons he learned from Howard Schnellenberger with him to this day as the head coach at Coconut Creek High School.

items.title: Game Preview: Owls look to weather the storm as FAU goes on the road for a marquee matchup against the Tulsa Golden Hurricane
items.summary: FAU Football (6-3, 3-2 AC) is officially bowl-bound, and they clinched a bowl game in dramatic fashion: a 60-29 win against a team that was previously undefeated in conference play, the UTSA Roadrunners (7-2, 4-1 AC). items.summary: Flashing lights, big plays, and loud fans were all at the Flagler Credit Union Stadium last week for Florida Atlantic. items.summary: FAU Football (5-3, 2-2 AC) is coming off their second conference loss into the season, and they head straight into the fire: three final games all against competitive conference opponents. items.summary: Flashing lights, loud fans, an ESPN crew, and the American conference’s number one team will all be at the Flagler Credit Union Stadium on Thursday night. items.title: FAU falls on the road in hard-fought game against Texas, 48-41
items.summary: The Florida Atlantic Owls (5-3, 2-2 AC) suffered a 48-41 conference loss Thursday night against the North Texas Mean Green (6-2, 4-0 AC). items.title: Editor-to-Editor: FAU heads to Denton for a marquee Primetime matchup against North Texas
items.summary: FAU Football (5-2, 2-1 AC) bounced back after a tough road loss to Army to defeat their conference foes, Rice (1-7, 0-4 AC), 51-49 in the Battle of the Owls. It won’t get any easier for the Owls this week, as they go on the road on a short week to face the North Texas...

items.title: University Press staff predict a high scoring Thursday night clash against North Texas
items.summary: After a 51-49 win against Rice (1-7, 0-4 AC), FAU (5-2, 2-1 AC) is officially one win away from being bowl-eligible. items.summary: After helping the Florida Atlantic Owls (5-2, 2-1 in AC) get their fifth win of the season against the Rice Owls (1-7, 0-4 in AC), wide receivers coach DJ McCarthy and FAU parted ways just two days later.
